fun_facts: Emmett Johnson was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
Emmett Johnson finished third among FBS rushers with 1,451 rushing yards in his breakout season.
He was named Big Ten Running Back of the Year and earned first-team all-conference honors.
Emmett Johnson led Big Ten running backs with 46 catches for 370 yards.
He topped 100 rushing yards in 8 of 12 games, including a 217-yard game against Iowa.

[Emmett Johnson KC RB](https://www.nfl.com/players/emmett-johnson-2)

**DRAFTED** : Round 5, No. 161 overall

Johnson leads all rookie running backs with 519 scrimmage yards and four touchdowns despite seeing a smaller percentage of touches than others in his class. He plays with tremendous energy and offers chunk-play ability on all three downs. In his first start in the Chiefs' backfield in Week 10, Johnson ran for 101 yards, had 70 yards receiving and added two scores. Johnson has quickly become a legitimate passing game weapon, recording a catch of 10 yards or more in seven of nine games and averaging 15.4 yards per reception.
